Hon'ble Rajnish Kumar,J.
1.

Mr. Ankit Mishra, Advocate has filed Vaklatnama on behalf of opposite party no. 2 today in Court,
which is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for applicants, Mr. Ankit Mishra, learned counsel for applicant no. 2,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material available on record.

3. By means of the present application under Section 528 of the Bhartiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023 (482 Cr.P.C.) the applicants have sought following prayer:-
Sabir Ali And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Deptt. Of ... on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/55874044/
1 "to quash the non-bailable warrant order dated 29.03.2023 issued against the applicants in Criminal CAse No. 1702 of 2022 (State Vs. Sabir Ali and others) arising out of Case Crime No. 338 of 2021 under Sections 406, 419 and 420 IPC, Police Station Kotwali, District Sitapur pending before learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Sitapur."
4. Learned counsel for applicants, after arguing at some length submits that grievance of the applicants shall be redressed in case liberty is granted to the applicants to file a bail application which may be decided in view of law laid down by Supreme Court in "Satender Kumar Antil versus Central Bureau of Investigation and another, Special Leave to Appeal (Cri)No.5191 of 2021" to which learned A.G.A. has no objection.
5.

So far as other prayer is concerned, it is provided that in case the applicants appear before the trial court within two weeks from today and apply for bail, the same shall be decided expeditiously, in view of the law laid down by Supreme Court in Satender Kumar Antil's case (supra).
6.
